items.title: Pope Leo needs no further lung cancer treatment, Vatican says
items.brief: Pope Leo XIV’s lung cancer surgery last week was a success and no further treatment is required, the Vatican press office said in a bulletin Wednesday.

items.title: Russia frees 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard captured in occupied Ukraine
items.brief: Russia has freed Stephen Hubbard, an American who had been imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on charges of fighting as a mercenary in Ukraine following a direct plea from US President Donald Trump.

items.title: New Mexico attorney general files civil lawsuit against two Epstein advisers
items.brief: New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez on Wednesday filed a civil lawsuit against two of Jeffrey Epstein’s closest advisers, accusing them of having “facilitated and concealed” Epstein’s crimes.
